text:
Predicates:
GivesOutRoses(x, y, t) ::: Roses are given out on TV x at time t.
OnMonday(t) ::: Time t is a Monday.
OnTV(x) ::: x is on TV.
Bachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor.
PortraysLivesOfRealPeople(x) ::: x portrays the lives of real people.
RealityTVShow(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
BreakingBad ::: the TV show Breaking Bad.
Premises:
∀t (OnMonday(t) → ∃x (GivesOutRoses(x, TV, t))) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀x, t (GivesOutRoses(x, TV, t) → OnTV(x)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (OnTV(x) → Bachelor(x)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (PortraysLivesOfRealPeople(x) → RealityTVShow(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTVShow(BreakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.
